description: D1: the Frostbound Titan's ice worked cold at Last Hearth's forge once he has fallen - ragged slabs of glacier ice crusted over the shoulders, the chest, the forearms and the shins, shards standing out of their rims, a crown of icicles, the Heart-ice. It keeps the cold off the giant who wears it: the rime that would freeze him takes less hold.

bonuses.name: Hoarfrost
bonuses.text: Rime takes 25% less hold on you: his cold is your cold

bonuses.name: The Watcher's Cold
bonuses.text: Rime takes a further 40% less hold, and poise +10: you stand in the cold as he stood in it
